pages.text: “A beautiful flower does not always bring fragrance—it may bring destruction.”$(br2)Wither Rose Tea is a dangerous yet potent beverage made from dried wither roses, blended with honey to balance its unique essence. Drinking it grants a powerful Strength boost, but there is also a chance that the traveler will be afflicted with the Wither effect.

$(br2)$(br)Wither Rose Tea must be prepared with caution—$(br)simply blend dried wither roses with honey to create this risky yet powerful tea.$(br)It is best consumed before battle, but be sure you can handle the potential side effects.

Upon drinking Wither Rose Tea, travelers gain a powerful Strength boost, significantly increasing attack power. However, there is also a chance of triggering the Wither effect, causing continuous damage.$(br)This is an extreme tea, suited for adventurers willing to take risks in exchange for great strength.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
